doc.hypothesis: A model trained only on earlier signals can tell which of the six rules' signals will net money after costs: the signals it scores highest net more than zero, and more than its lowest-scored signals by at least the cost gap.
doc.data: DATA/runs/y2/features_ctx.jsonl.gz: the six rules' filled signals (research dataset y2, code f8d054b) with point-in-time context (context.py, commit bc20ca6). Label: net_bp, the simulated net at market entry with measured costs (pessimistic reading).

derived.breadth_side: breadth for longs, 1 - breadth for shorts

doc.excluded: every outcome field: filled, entry_t, exit_t, ep, xp, qty, gross, fees, net, reason, gross_bp, net_bp, hold_min
doc.model: LightGBM regressor, fixed settings, no tuning: n_estimators=400, learning_rate=0.03, num_leaves=31, min_child_samples=500, subsample=0.8 (every iteration), colsample_bytree=0.8, reg_lambda=5.0, random_state=11, objective l2; the training target winsorised at the training sample's 1st and 99th percentiles; 'rule' as a categorical feature.
doc.walk_forward: Expanding window: refitted at the start of every calendar month on all signals of earlier sessions, scoring that month only. First scored month: May 2025.
doc.gate: Take a signal only if its score is at or above the 80th percentile of that month's model's scores on its own training signals (a cutoff known before the month starts).
doc.leakage_controls: Before any result is read, and any failure = NO-GO: (1) the feature list contains no outcome field; (2) label shuffle — the same procedure with each training month's labels shuffled must give a holdout top-minus-bottom quintile spread with |t| < 2.

metrics.gated: pooled mean net bp per gated signal on the holdout, t-statistic clustered by session
metrics.spread: holdout signals split into quintiles by score (pooled); for each session with signals in both, the top quintile's mean net minus the bottom's; the mean of that daily spread and its t-statistic

doc.decision: GO if: gated holdout mean net > 0 with clustered t >= 3.0 (stricter than 2: this is about the 13th filter tried in this programme) AND the quintile spread >= 4 bp with t >= 2 AND the shuffle control passes. Otherwise NO-GO — plan decision point D2: AI signal work stops, the ledger, gated books and review stay as risk tools.
doc.always_reported: per-rule gated means; the development period; the share of signals gated.
